$comment: INV-GA-10 inventory (GA-P-01). Declares which apps/pages local stores are the authority share ledger, and which similarly named modules are not. A filename heuristic alone would treat application OIDC grants and Access roles as rival ledgers.

notLedgers.reason: Browser-local application OIDC grants (tokens issued to relying parties). Not the share-authority ledger; ADR 0115 binds connectors through local-share-grants instead.
Admin UI helpers over local-grant-store application registrations, not a second authority model.
Access-panel role labels for the local directory. Roles here do not grant ConnectionRef authority; share grants do.
Pending access-request ceremonies. Settlement writes into local-share-grants; this file is the inbox, not the ledger.
In-flight application authorization codes and presentations. Cleared on vault lock; not durable share authority.
Registered local relying-party metadata (redirect URIs, scopes). Authority to act is still a share grant.
Bookmarks and local mirrors of Host shared sessions (ADR 0079). Writes durable share rows through local-share-grants; it is not a second ledger.
Host API client for shared-session open/grant/revoke. Authority persisted on the device still goes through local-share-grants.
SIOPv2 self-issued redirect ceremony over local application registrations. Not a share-grant store.
